name: device-quote
title: Hearing device quote
for_each: select distinct c.id,c.code from clients c join devices d on d.client_id=c.id where d.outcome in ('trial','kept') and d.fitted_on>current_date-90 order by c.code

sections.title: Client
sections.sql: select c.code,c.name,c.dob,c.address,c.funder,v.voucher_expires from clients c join v_clients v on v.client_id=c.id where c.id=$1

sections.title: Devices
sections.note: Includes the warranty period. The client signs and dates this quote on the day they receive it.
sections.sql: select model,ear,serial,funder,price,warranty_until,trial_ends from v_devices where client_id=$1 and outcome in ('trial','kept') and fitted_on>current_date-90 order by ear

sections.title: Returns policy
sections.sql: select 'Return within the trial for a refund of the device price, less any fee set out in the clinic''s returns policy. Trial length ' || value || ' days.' as policy from settings where key='trial_days' and $1::uuid is not null

sections.title: Signed
sections.sql: select name, '______________________' as client_signature, '__________' as date from clients where id=$1

name: device-record
title: Hearing aid record
for_each: select distinct c.id,c.code from clients c join devices d on d.client_id=c.id where d.outcome in ('trial','kept') order by c.code

sections.title: Hearing aids
sections.sql: select model,ear,serial,fitted_on,outcome,warranty_until,at_repair from v_devices where client_id=$1 and outcome in ('trial','kept') order by fitted_on desc,ear

sections.title: Repairs
sections.sql: select r.code,d.model,d.serial,r.sent_on,r.fault,r.under_warranty,r.returned_on,r.cost from repairs r join v_devices d on d.device_id=r.device_id where d.client_id=$1 order by r.sent_on desc

sections.title: Hearing tests
sections.sql: select tested_on,left_4fa,right_4fa,worse_by,recommendation from v_tests where client_id=$1 order by tested_on desc

name: statement
title: Statement of account
for_each: select client_id as id,client as code from v_balances where owing>0 order by client

sections.title: Account
sections.sql: select client,name,charged,paid,owing,oldest_due from v_balances where client_id=$1

sections.title: Invoices
sections.sql: select code,issued_on,due_on,description,amount from invoices where client_id=$1 order by issued_on

sections.title: Payments received
sections.sql: select p.paid_on,p.ref,p.amount from payments p join invoices i on i.id=p.invoice_id where i.client_id=$1 order by p.paid_on
